156.old: The Official Community Plan holds Thornhill as a long-term Urban Reserve. Urban development will not be supported there until the City’s population exceeds 100,000 and the residential capacity within the existing urban area is approaching build-out.

166.old: The City’s lot-size guide for rural designations is in the Official Community Plan, Chapter 3. Rural Residential lots are generally 0.8 hectares (about 2 acres) where community water is available and 2.0 hectares (about 4.9 acres) where water is on site.
